questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding Paleolithic tools:
(a) They were primarily made using the core tool technique.
(b) Microliths were dominant during this phase.
(c) Hand-axes are a characteristic feature of the Lower Paleolithic.
 Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Microliths belong to the Mesolithic age, not Paleolithic. Lower Paleolithic is known for hand-axes made using the core tool technique.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
माइक्रोलिथ मध्यपाषाण काल से संबंधित हैं। निम्न पुरापाषाण काल में कोर टूल तकनीक से बने हस्तकुठार पाए जाते हैं।

questions.question: Which of the following doctrines is common to both Buddhism and Jainism?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Both Buddhism and Jainism reject the Vedas but strongly uphold karma and rebirth.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
बौद्ध और जैन धर्म वेदों को नहीं मानते, लेकिन कर्म और पुनर्जन्म के सिद्धांत को स्वीकार करते हैं।

questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding Ashoka’s Dhamma:
(a) It emphasized social harmony and tolerance.
(b) It was identical to Buddhist philosophy.
(c) It promoted respect for elders and non-violence.
 Which of the statements are correct?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Ashoka’s Dhamma was a moral code, not a religious doctrine identical to Buddhism.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
अशोक का धम्म नैतिक आचार संहिता था, न कि बौद्ध धर्म का प्रतिरूप।

questions.question: Which of the following sites is associated with dockyard evidence in the Indus Valley Civilization?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Lothal in Gujarat provides clear archaeological evidence of a dockyard.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
गुजरात का लोथल स्थल सिंधु सभ्यता के गोदी का स्पष्ट प्रमाण देता है।

questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding Sabha and Samiti:
(a) Sabha was a smaller body of elites.
(b) Samiti was a popular assembly.
(c) Women participated in both assemblies.
 Which of the statements are correct?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Early Vedic texts mention participation of women like Gargi and Maitreyi.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
प्रारंभिक वैदिक काल में गार्गी और मैत्रेयी जैसी महिलाओं की भागीदारी का उल्लेख मिलता है।

questions.question: Which Mahajanapada emerged as the most powerful before the rise of the Mauryas?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Magadha gained supremacy due to fertile land, iron resources, and strong rulers.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
उपजाऊ भूमि, लौह संसाधन और शक्तिशाली शासकों के कारण मगध सबसे शक्तिशाली बना।

questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding punch-marked coins:
(a) They were made of silver.
(b) They had inscriptions in Brahmi script.
(c) They were issued during the Mahajanapada period.
 Which of the above are correct?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Punch-marked coins lacked inscriptions and symbols were punched.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
आहत सिक्कों पर लेख नहीं होते थे, केवल प्रतीक अंकित किए जाते थे।

questions.question: Which council marked the final split between Hinayana and Mahayana Buddhism?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
The Fourth Buddhist Council under Kanishka formalized the split.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
कनिष्क के संरक्षण में चतुर्थ बौद्ध संगीति से विभाजन स्पष्ट हुआ।

questions.question: Which of the following animals is most frequently depicted on Indus seals?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
The unicorn bull is the most common motif on Indus seals.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
सिंधु सभ्यता की मुहरों पर एकशृंगी बैल सबसे अधिक पाया जाता है।

questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding Megasthenes:
(a) He was a Greek ambassador to Chandragupta Maurya.
(b) His work ‘Indica’ survives completely.
(c) He described the Mauryan administration.
 Which are correct?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Indica survives only in fragments quoted by later authors.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
‘इंडिका’ केवल अंशों में उपलब्ध है।

questions.question: Which metal was first used extensively during the Later Vedic period?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Iron tools facilitated agriculture and territorial expansion.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
लोहे के औजारों से कृषि और विस्तार संभव हुआ।

questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding Satavahanas:
(a) They issued lead coins.
(b) They promoted Prakrit language.
(c) They followed a strictly matriarchal system.
 Which are correct?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Though queens were prominent, the system was not matriarchal.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
रानियों की भूमिका महत्वपूर्ण थी, लेकिन व्यवस्था मातृसत्तात्मक नहीं थी।

questions.question: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Makkhali Gosala was the founder of the Ajivika sect.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
मखलि गोसाल आजीवक संप्रदाय के संस्थापक थे।

questions.question: Which among the following was NOT a feature of Harappan town planning?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Harappan cities followed rectangular grid patterns.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
हड़प्पाई नगर आयताकार ग्रिड योजना पर आधारित थे।

questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding Stupas:
(a) They housed relics of the Buddha.
(b) Toranas depict Jataka stories.
(c) They originated during the Gupta period.
 Which are correct?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Stupas originated earlier, especially under Mauryas.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
स्तूपों की उत्पत्ति मौर्य काल में हुई थी, गुप्त काल में नहीं।

questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding Mesolithic culture:
(a) Microliths were its defining feature.
(b) Evidence of domestication of animals is found.
(c) It was entirely dependent on food gathering.
 Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Mesolithic age shows transition with microliths and early domestication; complete dependence on food gathering ended.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
मध्यपाषाण काल संक्रमण काल था जहाँ माइक्रोलिथ और पशुपालन के प्रारंभिक प्रमाण मिलते हैं।

questions.question: Which of the following texts is considered the earliest Buddhist literature?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Sutta Pitaka contains the earliest sermons of the Buddha.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
सुत्त पिटक में बुद्ध के प्रारंभिक उपदेश संकलित हैं।

questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding Dholavira:
(a) It is located in the Rann of Kutch.
(b) It shows evidence of a sophisticated water management system.
(c) It lacked city fortifications.
 Which are correct?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Dholavira had massive fortifications and advanced reservoirs.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
धोलावीरा में विशाल दुर्ग और उन्नत जल संरचनाएँ थीं।

questions.question: Which term was used for land grants in the Later Vedic period?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Dana’ referred to voluntary gifts, including land.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
‘दान’ स्वैच्छिक उपहारों के लिए प्रयुक्त होता था, जिसमें भूमि भी शामिल थी।

questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding Ajivikas:
(a) They believed in strict determinism.
(b) They accepted the authority of the Vedas.
(c) They practiced severe asceticism.
 Which are correct?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Ajivikas rejected the Vedas but believed in fate and asceticism.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
आजीवक वेदों को नहीं मानते थे, पर नियतिवाद और तपस्या में विश्वास करते थे।

questions.question: Which Mahajanapada was ruled by a republican form of government?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Vajji was a confederacy with republican institutions.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
वज्जि एक संघात्मक गणराज्य था।

questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding Arthashastra:
(a) It was written by Kautilya.
(b) It deals with Mauryan administration.
(c) It advocates democratic governance.
 Which are correct?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Arthashastra supports a strong centralized monarchy.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
अर्थशास्त्र केंद्रीकृत राजतंत्र का समर्थन करता है।

questions.question: Which of the following rulers issued bilingual inscriptions?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Ashoka’s inscriptions appear in Prakrit, Greek, and Aramaic.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
अशोक के अभिलेख प्राकृत, यूनानी और अरामाइक में मिलते हैं।

questions.question: Which animal is conspicuously absent in Harappan archaeological remains?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Horse remains are scarce and debated in Harappan context.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
हड़प्पाई सभ्यता में घोड़े के प्रमाण अत्यंत दुर्लभ और विवादित हैं।

questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding Varna system:
(a) It became rigid during the Early Vedic period.
(b) It was occupation-based initially.
(c) Shudras were excluded from rituals in Later Vedic period.
 Which are correct?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Rigidity increased in Later Vedic period, not early.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
वर्ण व्यवस्था उत्तर वैदिक काल में कठोर हुई।

questions.question: Who among the following was a contemporary of Chandragupta Maurya?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Seleucus fought and later allied with Chandragupta Maurya.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
सेल्युकस ने चंद्रगुप्त से युद्ध कर बाद में संधि की।

questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding Indo-Greeks:
(a) They introduced gold coins in India.
(b) Menander embraced Buddhism.
(c) They promoted Gandhara art.
 Which are correct?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Gold coins became common later; Gandhara art flourished under Indo-Greeks.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
स्वर्ण सिक्के बाद में प्रचलित हुए; गांधार कला इंडो-यूनानियों से जुड़ी है।

questions.question: Which of the following sites provides evidence of fire altars?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Kalibangan is known for fire altars and ploughed fields.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
कालीबंगा में अग्निकुंड और जुताई किए गए खेत मिले हैं।

questions.question: Which Buddhist concept means the middle path?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
The Eightfold Path represents the Middle Way.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
अष्टांगिक मार्ग ही मध्यम मार्ग का प्रतीक है।

questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding Rock-cut architecture:
(a) It flourished under the Mauryas.
(b) Barabar caves are its earliest examples.
(c) It declined completely after Mauryas.
 Which are correct?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Rock-cut architecture continued under Satavahanas and others.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
शैल-कट वास्तुकला मौर्यों के बाद भी जारी रही।

questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding Upper Paleolithic period:
(a) Blade tools became common.
(b) Cave paintings emerged during this phase.
(c) Agriculture was fully developed.
 Which of the above statements are correct?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Upper Paleolithic is known for blade tools and cave art, not agriculture.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
उच्च पुरापाषाण काल में ब्लेड औजार और गुफा चित्रकला मिलती है, कृषि नहीं।

questions.question: Which of the following features distinguishes Jainism from Buddhism?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Syadvada (theory of relativity) is unique to Jain philosophy.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
स्याद्वाद सिद्धांत जैन दर्शन की विशिष्ट विशेषता है।

questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding seals of the Indus Valley Civilization:
(a) They were generally made of steatite.
(b) They were used mainly for religious purposes.
(c) They depict animal motifs and script.
 Which are correct?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Seals were primarily used for trade and identification, not only religion.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
मुहरों का उपयोग व्यापार और पहचान हेतु था, न कि केवल धार्मिक कार्यों के लिए।

questions.question: Which of the following taxes is mentioned in the Rig Vedic period?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Bali was a voluntary offering to the chief in early Vedic society.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
बलि ऋग्वैदिक काल में स्वैच्छिक उपहार के रूप में दी जाती थी।

questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding the First Buddhist Council:
(a) It was held at Rajgir.
(b) It was patronized by Ashoka.
(c) Ananda recited the Sutta Pitaka.
 Which are correct?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
The First Council was held under Ajatashatru, not Ashoka.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
प्रथम संगीति अजातशत्रु के संरक्षण में हुई थी, अशोक के नहीं।

questions.question: Which factor contributed most to the rise of Magadha?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Iron resources enabled strong weapons and agricultural tools.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
लौह संसाधनों से शक्तिशाली हथियार और कृषि उपकरण बने।

questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding Mauryan administration:
(a) The empire was divided into provinces.
(b) Provinces were governed by Kumara.
(c) Local administration was completely autonomous.
 Which are correct?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Mauryan administration was centralized, not autonomous.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
मौर्य प्रशासन केंद्रीकृत था, स्वायत्त नहीं।

questions.question: Which of the following rulers is associated with the Heliodorus Pillar?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Heliodorus pillar was erected during the reign of Bhagabhadra.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
हेलियोडोरस स्तंभ भागभद्र के शासनकाल से संबंधित है।

questions.question: Which Harappan site is located on the banks of river Ravi?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Harappa is situated on the river Ravi.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
हड़प्पा रावी नदी के किनारे स्थित है।

questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding Ashram system:
(a) It was fully developed in the Early Vedic period.
(b) Vanaprastha emphasized withdrawal from worldly life.
(c) Sannyasa represented renunciation.
 Which are correct?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Ashram system matured in the Later Vedic period.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
आश्रम व्यवस्था उत्तर वैदिक काल में विकसित हुई।

questions.question: Which Buddhist text records the dialogue between King Menander and Nagasena?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Milindapanha records philosophical discussions with Menander.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
मिलिंदपन्ह में मेनांडर और नागसेन के संवाद मिलते हैं।

questions.question: Which of the following metals was least used in the Indus Valley Civilization?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Iron technology was not known to the Harappans.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
हड़प्पाई सभ्यता में लोहे का ज्ञान नहीं था।

questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding the Sunga dynasty:
(a) It was founded by Pushyamitra Shunga.
(b) It replaced the Mauryan dynasty.
(c) It actively promoted Buddhism.
 Which are correct?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Pushyamitra is often linked with Brahmanical revival.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
पुष्यमित्र शुंग को ब्राह्मणवाद के पुनरुत्थान से जोड़ा जाता है।

questions.question: Which Indus Valley site provides evidence of a ploughed field?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Kalibangan shows furrow marks of ploughed fields.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
कालीबंगा में जुताई किए गए खेतों के निशान मिले हैं।

questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding Jain Councils:
(a) First council was held at Pataliputra.
(b) It was held under the patronage of Chandragupta Maurya.
(c) It led to division between Shvetambaras and Digambaras.
 Which are correct?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
The division occurred gradually after the council.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
विभाजन संगीति के बाद क्रमिक रूप से हुआ।

questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding Neolithic culture:
(a) Polished stone tools were used.
(b) Pottery and weaving were known.
(c) Complete urbanization had occurred.
 Which of the above statements are correct?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Neolithic age marks food production but not urban life.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
नवपाषाण काल में खाद्य उत्पादन था, पर शहरीकरण नहीं।

questions.question: Which of the following principles forms the core of Jain philosophy?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Ahimsa is the central doctrine of Jainism.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
अहिंसा जैन धर्म का केंद्रीय सिद्धांत है।

questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding weights and measures in the Indus Valley Civilization:
(a) A binary system was followed.
(b) Weights were generally cubical.
(c) Standardization was absent.
 Which are correct?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Harappan weights show remarkable standardization.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
हड़प्पाई बाट अत्यधिक मानकीकरण दर्शाते हैं।

questions.question: Which of the following Vedas contains information about rituals and sacrifices?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Yajurveda provides prose formulas for rituals.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
यजुर्वेद में यज्ञों की विधियाँ वर्णित हैं।

questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding the Second Buddhist Council:
(a) It was held at Vaishali.
(b) It dealt with monastic discipline.
(c) It resulted in the split between Hinayana and Mahayana.
 Which are correct?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Major sectarian split occurred later, not in the Second Council.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
प्रमुख संप्रदाय विभाजन बाद में हुआ, द्वितीय संगीति में नहीं।

questions.question: Which Mahajanapada had its capital at Ujjaini?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Ujjaini was the capital of Avanti.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
उज्जयिनी अवंति की राजधानी थी।

questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding revenue administration under the Mauryas:
(a) Land revenue was the chief source of income.
(b) Revenue was usually one-sixth of produce.
(c) Tax collection was left to village assemblies.
 Which are correct?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Mauryan revenue system was centrally controlled.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
मौर्य राजस्व व्यवस्था केंद्रीकृत थी।

questions.question: Which Indo-Greek ruler is best known for his patronage of Buddhism?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Menander (Milinda) is associated with Buddhist philosophy.
